name: Acrobiosystems Co.,Ltd.
summary: Acrobiosystems Co.,Ltd. engages in the development and manufacture of recombinant proteins, antibodies, and other biological reagents for pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies, and research institutions. It provides kits, scientific services, and other related products under the Resilient Supply, CytoPak, SAFENSURE, FLAG, Star Staining, Aneuro, ComboX, and GENPower brands. The company also offers cell therapies, gene therapies, therapeutic antibodies, antibody-drug conjugates, core reagents for infectious disease research, and solutions for metabolic and autoimmune disease drug development.
